correctness_evidence: Actual glyph-data precedence and effective placement are reused during capture. Glyph masks and fixed paths are detached, then the same accepted plan supplies full and strip replay without a second font resource read.

Ordered operations affecting the overlap must exactly match after checked integer translation. Changed color, selection/background, physical phase, clipping, glyph output or actual consumed mask refuse reuse.

Uniform finite source bounds and initial fully opaque coverage are checked. Unsupported image/color/transform/path effects or SVG/bitmap/stroked/decorated/vertical/math text fall back; zero text clips fall back. No-paint standard-box Paths are ignored.
Owned pane pixels are captured before later overlapping siblings; full parent redraw cannot erase restored panes. Disjoint dirty rectangles avoid applying translucent text twice.

Current adapter oracle strips hints from actual painted commands and compares complete software RGBA pixels. Repeat position forces Scene.NeedsRender; source/text change, selection and disabled transitions are included. Aggregate reuse must be nonzero.
Pixel cache <=32MiB/64groups and retained descriptor payload <=8MiB; tight arrays/masks prevent explicit slice-capacity undercount. Eviction, resize and clock exhaustion retire pixels and plans.
decision: Approved frozen v4 integrated Stage39 source and stated correctness contract. No remaining material finding in reviewed inputs. Performance qualification remains separate.
limits: Reviewer executed only read/hash/reconstruction scripts, no Go/native/GUI/provider tests. Qualification execution belongs to recorded producers.
Logical retained payload limits exclude Go allocator/map metadata; replacement capture temporarily overlaps old plan and builder/trim allocations. They do not bound peak process/native/GPU memory.
New relative curve interpolation intentionally changes some preceding-kernel antialias edge pixels. Full-replay differential oracle uses the new kernel; preceding-kernel pixel parity is not claimed.

Normal full scene GPU copy/upload remains unchanged. No strip-only GPU transfer, compositor/GPU completion, physical presentation timing, general latency improvement or 4/6ms target acceptance is certified.

Three live Cocoa process receipts and old-kernel meaningful-negative receipt are hash-checked supplemental evidence, not human input, external accessibility, VoiceOver, OS-setting or whole-Mac acceptance.
Other renderers retain original flat commands; their metadata ignoring is reviewed structurally, not separately rerun in this review.
